what: Concept A: Single Births vs. Multiple Litters vs. Continuous Egg Laying
title: Herd Demography & Population Dynamics
text: Cattle (Single-birth monotocous): Cows long 9-month gestation conceive single calf. Therefore, biological rhythm strictly annual (1 calving per cow per year). main driver births success breeding: pregnancy rate (pregnancy_rate), split equally (50:50) male female calves. Prolificacy (pr_sheep_goat): Multiple births per parturition (singles, twins, triplets). Parturition frequency: traditional seasonal systems, ewes lamb per calendar year (365-day cycle). intensified systems accelerated breeding schedules, lambing interval shortened (e.g., 200 days, yielding 1.825 lambings per ewe per year). Swine (Continuous litter-bearing): Sows high fecundity non-seasonal. key driver farrowing interval (gestation + lactation + weaning--service interval, averaging 148.9 days, 2.45 litters per sow per year) combined large weaned litter size (piglets_suckling). Poultry (Continuous egg laying): Birds experience mammalian pregnancies parturitions; lay eggs continuously throughout batch laying curve. broiler breeder flocks, fertile hatching eggs (daily egg output multiplied fertility rate) hatch day-old chicks move directly broiler houses.
